title: Step 59-B header responsive navigation and search entry
description: Productionize the Storefront header/navigation/search-entry surface only. Replace the header search link with an accessible GET search form, align quick-action keyboard order with the frozen discovery contract, harden compact navigation disclosure/Escape behavior, preserve responsive/RTL/accessibility invariants, and add dedicated deterministic Stage-B verification. Do not implement Home merchandising, category/brand discovery data, search suggestions/results, listing/filter/sort/pagination, product, compare/wishlist behavior, cart/checkout behavior, backend/API authority, or new dependencies.

dependencies.name: Canonical handoff and discovery scope freeze

acceptance_criteria.description: The header exposes a semantic GET search form that submits only q to /search; the Step-60 search route remains a placeholder and no search-results/suggestions API behavior is implemented.

Compact primary navigation preserves aria-expanded/aria-controls, closes after navigation, supports Escape close with focus return to the toggle, and does not invent positive tabindex or autofocus behavior.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront navigation:verify && pnpm --dir apps/storefront quality:static

acceptance_criteria.description: Header keyboard source order is skip-link, Home/wordmark, search, account, cart, primary navigation, then breadcrumbs/main; all interactive controls retain the 44px target and visible-focus contracts.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront navigation:verify && pnpm --dir apps/storefront quality:static

acceptance_criteria.description: Responsive Header/Nav/Search CSS remains logical-RTL, no brown, no clipping/nowrap/row-reverse, and continues to support canonical 320/360/600/840/1200/1440 behavior without introducing a new dependency.

Full root pnpm verify, exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, deterministic review, active exact-artifact lock, protected Merge Policy merge and exact-SHA postmerge verification pass before Stage 59-C starts.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 59-B is MEDIUM risk. No direct-main write or raw merge is canonical. Stage 59-C remains forbidden until protected transport and exact-SHA post-merge verification are green.
